title: 1991 AHSME Problem 8
statement: Liquid \(X\) does not mix with water. Unless obstructed, it spreads out on the surface of water to form a circular film \(0.1\) cm thick. A rectangular box measuring \(6\) cm by \(3\) cm by \(12\) cm is filled with liquid \(X.\) Its contents are poured onto a large body of water. What will be the radius, in centimeters, of the resulting circular film?

solutions.text:
The liquid volume is \(6\cdot3\cdot12=216\) cubic centimeters. Thus \[ 0.1\pi r^2=216, \] so \(r^2=\frac{2160}{\pi}\) and \(r=\sqrt{\frac{2160}{\pi}}.\)

Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: Equate the volume in the box to the volume of the thin circular film
